requirements.text: Customers should be able to book appointments online anytime, selecting services, barbers, and time slots, with instant confirmation via text or email.
Customers should have the option to cancel or reschedule their appointments online.
Customers should receive reminders 24 hours and one hour before their appointment.
The system needs to be cost-effective for a small barbershop.
The system must comply with data protection laws for customer information.
Enforce a cancellation policy that requires at least 24 hours’ notice with a grace period for first-time clients.
Reporting features should provide daily and weekly summaries of bookings, cancellations, and no-shows.
Track customer no-show history for review.
Identify peak hours or days for better decision-making.
Manage barber schedules efficiently, allowing them to set their own hours and avoid double bookings.
